operational_definition: One visible non-writing contour cluster is mechanically nearest the localized inscription in the context box.
Tie, clipping, fading, or writing/component ambiguity prevents a unique nearest-component selection.
Selected component contains at least one visibly closed broad lobe oval or blade-like outline.
Context is sufficient and selected component contains no visibly closed broad lobe oval or blade-like outline.
Context or component selection does not support a secure binary call.
One continuous selected component visibly divides into at least two arms within the context box.
Context is sufficient and no such visible division occurs in the selected component.
Context or component selection does not support a secure binary call.
Colored wash or fill is visibly present inside or on the selected component beyond outline ink alone.
Context is sufficient and selected component is visible as unfilled linework.
Context or component selection does not support a secure binary call.
